newsitem.title: USA: Applied Voice backs $0.28 Q2 EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: Applied Voice backs $0.28 Q2 EPS estimate.

text.p: Applied Voice Technology Inc said Tuesday it backs an analyst's earnings estimates of $0.28 a share for second quarter and $1.18 for the full year.
"We are comfortable with the predictions," president and chief executive Richard LaPorte said Tuesday in an interview after a meeting at the Piper Jaffray conference here.
In 1996, the company reported second quarter earnings of $0.24 a share and $1.02 for the year.
LaPorte said the company continues to look for new acquisitions. It recently bought two companies.

"We are looking for either strength in technology or in distribution in companies we are considering buying," LaPorte told attendees of the annual Piper Jaffray conference in Minneapolis. "We expect to add one more company before the end of the year."
The Kirkland, Wash-based company provides computer telephony software products.
